scenario.name: blocked_station
scenario.description: A box is left on the PICK_B approach pose just after the robot collects P1, so the robot cannot reach the pose it must stop at to collect P2.

ground_truth.summary: A static obstacle occupies the PICK_B approach pose; the goal pose itself is unreachable.

alerts: a 0.8 m obstacle not in the map appeared on the PICK_B stopping pose (a goal to that waypoint failed), seen from 45.3 s to 49.3 s

diagnosis.root_cause: The mission ended before the obstacle appeared. The obstacle on PICK_B was detected at 45.3 s, but the recording ended at 50.2 s with navigation still running for PICK_B. Since no planner/controller failures, localization issues, actuator faults, or parameter changes occurred during the actual navigation window (0-35.8 s), and the robot was moving normally, the failure to complete the mission is attributed to the recording ending prematurely rather than a fault in the system.
evidence: Mission ended at 50.2 s with PICK_B still running
Obstacle on PICK_B first seen at 45.3 s (after navigation had already been attempted)
No planner or controller failures recorded
Localization stable with no pose jumps
Motion commands executed normally with measured speeds matching commanded speeds

decision.note: The diagnosis category is 'no_fault'. The mission failure was due to the recording ending prematurely, not a system fault. No recovery actions are required.

alerts: a 0.7 m obstacle not in the map appeared on the PICK_B stopping pose (a goal to that waypoint failed), seen from 45.3 s to 73.3 s

actions.why: an obstacle was seen on the PICK_B stopping pose
a message for a person; nothing on the robot changes

diagnosis.root_cause: A 0.7 m obstacle appeared on the PICK_B waypoint's stopping pose between 45.3 s and 73.3 s, preventing the robot from reaching the goal.
evidence: Obstacle first seen at 45.3s, last seen at 73.3s
Pickup P2 goal cancelled after 36.6s and still running at end of recording (74.2s) due to this obstacle

decision.note: The diagnosis category is 'blocked_station'. Per instructions, the robot cannot move the obstacle. Parcel P2 is awaiting pickup at PICK_B and its next goal is PICK_B, which is blocked by the obstacle. Therefore, defer P2 and escalate to remove the obstacle.
